title: How a Blind Developer Uses Visual Studio (Microsoft Build 2017)
summary: Saqib Shaikh, a blind developer at Microsoft, shows at Build 2017 how he writes and debugs code in Visual Studio using a screen reader. This version adds subtitles.
why: HN uses it as the go-to example of how blind developers work, including the very fast screen reader speech.

quote.text: my go to example of this is this talk by Saqib Shaikh
